services.name: Our Balloons
services.desc: Hot Air Balloons beautifully designed by the industry leader with the best passenger comfort and safety in mind! Carefully crafted with the worlds best available fabrics, all of Ultramagic's hot air balloons are made of Ultralast 90 gram rip-stop nylon. Ultramagic designed their first balloon in 1980 to be used in an expedition across Africa that included 40 consecutive hot air balloon flights in a span of 11 months. Ultramagic has gone on to produce thousands of hot air balloons that fly worldwide.
